run_download_youtube: run the download_youtube function to fetch YouTube videos from annotation files using yt_dlp
run_download_droid: run the download_droid function to download DROID dataset videos from Google Cloud Storage
run_download_ego4d: run the download_ego4d function to download Ego4D dataset videos using the ego4d CLI tool
run_download_sav: run the download_sav function to download and extract the SA-V dataset videos tar archive
run_construct_gcs_path: run the construct_gcs_path function to convert a DROID video filename into a GCS path
